## Action
Late night, no one watching. Elena runs diagnostics she's avoided for weeks.

## Gap
The corruption is worse than she thought. Some of the earliest archives — the children she most wanted to save — are degrading.

## Choice
She locks the data. No one can see it yet. She just needs time to find a solution.

## Shift
Active deception replaces passive doubt. She's no longer just questioning — she's hiding.
